resources.string: Choose what your other phone can receive. Android asks for access when you turn a feature on.
Turn on Bluetooth on both phones. Allow Nearby devices on this phone, then scan its QR code from the receiver.
Use the receiver for call audio
Optional. Bluetooth handles call alerts, contacts and texts. To carry your voice too, set up call audio on this phone.
Open Sharing and turn on Call alerts and Call control to answer on the receiver.
Connect to Wi-Fi and pair this app in Developer options. Tap for the pairing steps.
Pairing saved on this phone. Tap to pair again if Android removed it.
When two-way audio is ready, answer on the receiving phone and allow its microphone.
Review sharing, Bluetooth pairing and call audio.
Choose what to share with your receiver.
Choose what to share, then scan this phone’s QR code with ezcall on your receiving phone.
Scan this code in ezcall Receiver on Android or ezcall on iPhone. It expires after two minutes.
Scan the code on the Connection tab.
Keep both phones nearby with Bluetooth on.
Start pairing to link a phone.
Remove the current link and show a new QR code. Your audio and sharing settings are kept.
If the receiving phone still shows the old link, forget this phone there before scanning.
Review these permissions whenever you need them in Sharing.
Keep both phones nearby, then scan the pairing code with the receiving app.
Check the relay and Android permissions.
Battery optimization is off for ezcall
Android may pause the relay to save battery
Answer on the receiving phone. Listen for beeps, then speak to hear your voice back.
Wait for the current call or reconnect and try again.
Allow ezcall notifications to show its relay icon in the status bar.
Battery optimization is already off for ezcall.
In Battery settings, choose Unrestricted for ezcall to keep the relay active.

Connect this phone to Wi-Fi. If Developer options is hidden, find Build number in About phone and tap it seven times.

Open Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code. Keep the code on screen.

Pull down notifications, tap Enter code in the ezcall notification, and enter the six digits. Return here and tap Set up call audio.
Connecting on this phone. You can stay in ezcall.
Use the receiving phone’s speaker and microphone for relayed calls.
Allow ezcall to appear over the call screen so you can take audio back on this phone.
This Android phone keeps call audio when it cannot transfer both the microphone and speaker.
Connect to Wi-Fi and turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options. Then return to ezcall and tap Restart call audio. You can close the settings screen.
Resume the relay to use call audio.
Set up call audio on this phone to forward your voice and incoming audio.
Share cellular call status with your paired phone.
Share the caller number when Android provides it. This uses call log permission.
Let your paired phone answer, decline, end and place calls on this phone\'s SIM.
Share text message contents and up to 100 recent SMS with your paired phone.
Let your paired phone send SMS from this Android SIM. Carrier charges may apply.
Share contact names and phone numbers with your paired phone.
Tap Pair with Wireless debugging first, then keep Wireless debugging on.
Connect to Wi-Fi and turn on Wireless debugging. If ezcall was removed from Paired devices, pair it again.
Could not find Wireless debugging automatically. Check that it is on, then retry or enter the connection port.
In Developer options → Wireless debugging, find “IP address and port” on the main screen. Return here and enter the number after the colon. The pairing window has a different port.
Use a cable and a computer with Android Platform-Tools.
Turn on USB debugging in Developer options. Connect this phone to your computer and approve its debugging request. Keep this dialog open and run this command within two minutes:\n\n%1$s
USB setup did not start call audio. Check the USB debugging prompt and run the command again from a fresh setup dialog.
Connected to Wireless debugging, but the call audio component did not respond. Try starting call audio again.

ezcall could not confirm that it reached Wireless debugging on this phone, so it did not start call audio. Another app may be imitating Wireless debugging. Turn Wireless debugging off and on, then try again.
This Android device does not support Bluetooth LE advertising.
Allow the Wireless debugging notifications to enter the pairing code.
Open Developer options and select Wireless debugging.
Open ezcall to start the relay.
Nearby devices permission is needed to pair.
Allow notifications to enter the Wireless debugging pairing code.
Android did not grant this permission.
Pairing code expired. Start pairing again.
Could not start relay. Check Bluetooth and Nearby devices permissions.
Nearby devices permission is needed to resume the relay.
Waiting for Bluetooth to turn on.
Receiving phone connected · Bluetooth relay active
Bluetooth relay active · Waiting for the receiving phone
Could not save the secure pairing.
Test audio needs the Bluetooth audio channel. Reconnect and try again.
Couldn’t remove the saved pairing. Try again.
Removing the link from the receiving phone…
Enter six digits, or the code and port as 123456:PORT.
Keep the system code window open and enter the six digits, a colon, then the port.
Pairing failed. Open a fresh code in Wireless debugging and try again.
ezcall is paired for local debugging.
In Wireless debugging, open Pair device with pairing code and leave that window open.
The Bluetooth service did not open.
The receiving phone confirmed it heard the beeps.
Waiting for the receiving phone to answer.
The receiving phone did not answer.
A cellular call interrupted the test.
Bluetooth could not queue the test call or its audio setup.
The Bluetooth connection was lost during the test.
Beep packets have not been queued.
Beep packets queued for the receiving phone.
The app could not generate the test beeps.
Playback has not been confirmed on the receiving phone.
Microphone packets received during the echo test.
No microphone packets received during the echo test. Check mute and microphone permission on the receiving phone.
Echo packets queued for the receiving phone.
Echo packets have not been queued.
Share this phone’s call audio details to help fix calls where your voice doesn’t reach the other person. No numbers, contacts or messages are included.
Checked in a real call: the receiving phone’s voice reached the SIM call.
